source.text: וַיָּ֡קָם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד־מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And arose Eliashib the priest, the great, and his brothers the priests, and they built the gate of the sheep; they consecrated it and set up its doors; and as far as [the] tower of the Hundred they consecrated it, as far as [the] tower of Hananel.

en.L: And Eliashib the high priest arose with his brothers the priests, and they built the Sheep Gate. They consecrated it and set up its doors, and they consecrated it as far as the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Tower of Hananel.
en.B: Then Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests set to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place. They built and dedicated the wall as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel.
en.R: Eliashib the high priest and the other priests started the work. They rebuilt the Sheep Gate, set its doors in place and dedicated it to God. They also rebuilt the wall as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel, and dedicated it.

es.L: Y se levantó Eliasib el sumo sacerdote con sus hermanos los sacerdotes, y edificaron la puerta de las Ovejas. Ellos la consagraron y pusieron sus hojas, y la consagraron hasta la torre de los Cien, hasta la torre de Hananel.
es.B: Entonces Eliasib el sumo sacerdote y sus compañeros sacerdotes se pusieron a trabajar y reconstruyeron la puerta de las Ovejas. La consagraron y colocaron sus hojas. Construyeron y consagraron el muro hasta la torre de los Cien y la torre de Hananel.
es.R: Eliasib el sumo sacerdote y los demás sacerdotes comenzaron el trabajo. Reconstruyeron la puerta de las Ovejas, colocaron sus puertas y la dedicaron a Dios. También reconstruyeron el muro hasta la torre de los Cien y la torre de Hananel, y lo dedicaron.

fr.L: Et Éliashib, le grand prêtre, se leva avec ses frères les prêtres, et ils bâtirent la porte des Brebis. Ils la consacrèrent et posèrent ses battants, et ils la consacrèrent jusqu’à la tour des Cent, jusqu’à la tour de Hananéel.
fr.B: Alors Éliashib, le grand prêtre, et ses frères les prêtres se mirent à l’œuvre et rebâtirent la porte des Brebis. Ils la consacrèrent et en posèrent les battants. Ils bâtirent et consacrèrent la muraille jusqu’à la tour des Cent et la tour de Hananéel.
fr.R: Éliashib, le grand prêtre, et les autres prêtres ont commencé le travail. Ils ont reconstruit la porte des Brebis, en ont posé les battants et l’ont consacrée à Dieu. Ils ont aussi reconstruit la muraille jusqu’à la tour des Cent et la tour de Hananéel, et ils l’ont consacrée.

sw.L: Ndipo Eliashibu kuhani mkuu akaondoka pamoja na ndugu zake makuhani, wakajenga Lango la Kondoo. Wakaliweka wakfu, wakaisimika milango yake; wakaliweka wakfu mpaka Mnara wa Mia, mpaka Mnara wa Hananeli.
sw.B: Kisha Eliashibu kuhani mkuu na makuhani wenzake walianza kazi, wakalijenga upya Lango la Kondoo. Wakaliweka wakfu na kuisimika milango yake. Wakaujenga ukuta na kuuweka wakfu mpaka Mnara wa Mia na Mnara wa Hananeli.
sw.R: Eliashibu kuhani mkuu na makuhani wengine walianza kazi. Walilijenga upya Lango la Kondoo, wakaiweka milango yake mahali pake, wakaliweka wakfu kwa Mungu. Waliujenga upya pia ukuta mpaka Mnara wa Mia na Mnara wa Hananeli, wakauweka wakfu.

vi.L: Và Ê-li-a-síp, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng các anh em mình là các thầy tế lễ, đứng dậy xây Cổng Chiên. Họ biệt riêng cổng ấy ra thánh và lắp các cánh cửa; họ biệt riêng ra thánh cho đến tháp Một Trăm, cho đến tháp Ha-na-nên.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-li-a-síp, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, cùng các thầy tế lễ anh em mình bắt tay vào việc và xây lại Cổng Chiên. Họ cung hiến cổng ấy và lắp các cánh cửa. Họ xây và cung hiến tường thành cho đến tháp Một Trăm và tháp Ha-na-nên.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Ê-li-a-síp và các thầy tế lễ khác bắt đầu công việc. Họ xây lại Cổng Chiên, lắp các cánh cửa và dâng cổng ấy cho Đức Chúa Trời. Họ cũng xây lại tường thành cho đến tháp Một Trăm và tháp Ha-na-nên, rồi dâng đoạn tường ấy cho Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 대제사장 엘리아십이 그의 형제 제사장들과 함께 일어나 양 문을 건축했다. 그들이 그것을 거룩하게 구별하고 그 문짝들을 달았으며, 함메아 망대까지, 하나넬 망대까지 거룩하게 구별했다.
ko.B: 그때 대제사장 엘리아십과 그의 동료 제사장들이 일어나 양 문을 다시 세웠다. 그들은 그 문을 봉헌하고 문짝들을 달았다. 또 성벽을 쌓아 함메아 망대와 하나넬 망대까지 봉헌했다.
ko.R: 대제사장 엘리아십과 다른 제사장들이 일을 시작했다. 그들은 양 문을 다시 세우고 문짝들을 달아 그 문을 하나님께 바쳤다. 그들은 또 함메아 망대와 하나넬 망대까지 성벽을 다시 쌓고 그것도 하나님께 바쳤다.

pt.L: E levantou-se Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, e os seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, e edificaram a Porta das Ovelhas. Eles a consagraram e colocaram as suas portas; e até a Torre dos Cem a consagraram, até a Torre de Hananel.
pt.B: Então Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, e os seus companheiros sacerdotes começaram o trabalho e reconstruíram a Porta das Ovelhas. Eles a consagraram e colocaram as suas portas no lugar. Construíram e consagraram o muro até a Torre dos Cem e a Torre de Hananel.
pt.R: Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, e os outros sacerdotes começaram o trabalho. Reconstruíram a Porta das Ovelhas, colocaram as suas portas no lugar e a consagraram a Deus. Também reconstruíram o muro até a Torre dos Cem e a Torre de Hananel, e o consagraram.

am.L: ሊቀ ካህናቱ ኤልያሴብም ከወንድሞቹ ከካህናቱ ጋር ተነሣ፤ የበጎችንም በር ሠሩ፤ ቀደሱት፤ መዝጊያዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ እስከ መቶው ማማ ድረስ ቀደሱት፤ እስከ ሐናንኤል ማማ ድረስ።
am.B: ከዚያም ሊቀ ካህናቱ ኤልያሴብና ካህናት ወንድሞቹ ተነሥተው የበጎችን በር እንደ ገና ሠሩ። ቀደሱት፤ መዝጊያዎቹንም በስፍራቸው አቆሙ። ቅጥሩንም እስከ መቶው ማማና እስከ ሐናንኤል ማማ ድረስ ሠርተው ቀደሱት።
am.R: ሊቀ ካህናቱ ኤልያሴብና ሌሎቹ ካህናት ሥራውን ጀመሩ። የበጎችን በር እንደ ገና ሠሩ፤ መዝጊያዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቀደሱት። ቅጥሩንም እስከ መቶው ማማና እስከ ሐናንኤል ማማ ድረስ እንደ ገና ሠርተው ቀደሱት።

hi.L: और एल्याशीब महायाजक अपने भाइयों, याजकों, के साथ उठा, और उन्होंने भेड़-फाटक बनाया। उन्होंने उसे पवित्र किया और उसके किवाड़ लगाए; और सौ के गुम्मट तक उन्होंने उसे पवित्र किया, हननेल के गुम्मट तक।
hi.B: तब एल्याशीब महायाजक और उसके साथी याजक काम में लग गए और उन्होंने भेड़-फाटक को फिर से बनाया। उन्होंने उसे पवित्र किया और उसके किवाड़ लगाए। उन्होंने सौ के गुम्मट और हननेल के गुम्मट तक शहरपनाह बनाई और उसे पवित्र किया।
hi.R: एल्याशीब महायाजक और दूसरे याजकों ने काम शुरू किया। उन्होंने भेड़-फाटक को फिर से बनाया, उसके किवाड़ लगाए और उसे परमेश्वर के लिए पवित्र किया। उन्होंने सौ के गुम्मट और हननेल के गुम्मट तक शहरपनाह भी फिर से बनाई, और उसे पवित्र किया।

ru.L: И встал Елиашив, первосвященник, и братья его священники, и построили они Овечьи ворота; они освятили их и поставили их двери; и до башни Сотни освятили их, до башни Хананеила.
ru.B: Тогда первосвященник Елиашив и его собратья-священники взялись за дело и отстроили Овечьи ворота. Они освятили их и поставили на место их двери. Они отстроили и освятили стену до башни Сотни и до башни Хананеила.
ru.R: Первосвященник Елиашив и другие священники начали работу. Они отстроили Овечьи ворота, поставили на место их двери и посвятили их Богу. Ещё они отстроили стену до башни Сотни и до башни Хананеила и тоже посвятили её Богу.

ja.L: そして、大祭司エルヤシブは、彼の兄弟である祭司たちと共に立ち上がり、羊の門を建てた。彼らはそれを聖別し、その扉を据えた。彼らは百の塔まで、ハナンエルの塔まで、それを聖別した。
ja.B: 大祭司エルヤシブと仲間の祭司たちは、立ち上がって羊の門を建て直した。彼らはそれを聖別し、扉を取り付けた。さらに、百の塔、ハナンエルの塔まで城壁を建てて聖別した。
ja.R: 大祭司エルヤシブと、ほかの祭司たちが工事を始めました。彼らは羊の門を建て直し、扉を取り付けて、それを神にささげました。また、百の塔とハナンエルの塔まで城壁を建て直し、それも神にささげました。

uk.L: І встав Еліашив, великий священник, і його брати священники, і збудували Овечу браму; вони освятили її і поставили її двері, і аж до Башти Сотні освятили її, аж до Башти Хананеїла.
uk.B: Тоді первосвященик Еліашив зі своїми братами священниками взявся до праці й відбудував Овечу браму. Вони освятили її і вставили її двері. Вони відбудували й освятили стіну аж до Башти Сотні й до Башти Хананеїла.
uk.R: Первосвященик Еліашив та інші священники почали роботу. Вони відбудували Овечу браму, вставили її двері й посвятили її Богові. Вони також відбудували стіну аж до Башти Сотні й до Башти Хананеїла і посвятили її.

decisions.choice: Eliashib the high priest: the head of the priests in Nehemiah's time
decisions.reason: Eliashib was the grandson of Jeshua, the high priest of the first return (12:10; Ezra 3:2). The list of builders begins with the priests, at the part of the wall nearest the temple. Later Eliashib let Tobiah use a room in the temple (13:4-7).

decisions.choice: the Sheep Gate, the Tower of the Hundred, the Tower of Hananel: the northeast of the city, north of the temple
decisions.reason: The list goes around the wall counterclockwise, from the Sheep Gate in the northeast (compare John 5:2) west along the north wall, down the west side, and back up the east (3:1-32), ending again at the Sheep Gate (3:32). The Tower of Hananel stood at the north wall (Jeremiah 31:38; Zechariah 14:10). The Tower of the Hundred may be named for its height or for a company of a hundred men; the text does not say.

decisions.choice: they consecrated it: they set it apart for God
decisions.reason: The priests dedicated their section, the part beside the temple, to God. The whole wall was dedicated when it was finished (12:27-43).

decisions.choice: the high priest
decisions.reason: "The great priest" is the Hebrew title of the high priest (Leviticus 21:10; Haggai 1:1).

decisions.choice: "puerta de las Ovejas", "torre de los Cien", "torre de Hananel"; the doors of a gate "sus hojas" (L, B), "sus puertas" (R)
decisions.reason: The names of the gates and towers as the terms note settles them. Spanish calls the leaves of a gate "hojas", which keeps "puerta" for the gateway at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "puertas", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("ils bâtirent"), passé composé at Readable ("ils ont reconstruit")
decisions.reason: The narrative tenses of the memoir, as set in 1:1, through the list of builders and Sanballat's mockery; the speeches of 3:34-35 and the prayer of 3:36-37 are in the tenses of speech.

decisions.choice: "porte des Brebis", "tour des Cent", "tour de Hananéel"; the doors of a gate "les battants"
decisions.reason: The names of the gates and towers as the terms note settles them (Hananéel as Jeremiah 31:38). A gate's doors are "battants", so that "porte" stays the gateway itself.

decisions.choice: "Lango la Kondoo", "Mnara wa Mia", "Mnara wa Hananeli"; the doors "milango"
decisions.reason: The names of the gates and towers as the terms note settles them; "lango" is the gateway and "milango" its doors.

decisions.choice: "Cổng Chiên", "tháp Một Trăm", "tháp Ha-na-nên"; the doors "các cánh cửa"
decisions.reason: The names of the gates and towers as the terms note settles them (Ha-na-nên as Jeremiah 31:38).

decisions.choice: "함메아 망대" for the Tower of the Hundred, at every level
decisions.reason: Korean keeps the Hebrew name, as it does for the Tower of Hananel; "Hammeah" means "the Hundred" (meaning decision m2), which a plain "백 망대" would not read as a name.

decisions.choice: "양 문"; the doors of a gate "문짝"
decisions.reason: The gate names in plain words with a space, as the terms note sets; "문짝" for the doors keeps "문" for the gateway.

decisions.choice: a Porta das Ovelhas; a Torre dos Cem; a Torre de Hananel
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the gates and towers are names (m2), written with capitals and one form at every level: a Porta das Ovelhas, a Porta dos Peixes, a Porta Velha, a Porta do Vale, a Porta do Monturo, a Porta da Fonte, a Porta das Águas, a Porta dos Cavalos, a Porta Oriental, a Porta da Inspeção; a Torre dos Cem, a Torre de Hananel, a Torre dos Fornos; o Muro Largo. Portuguese translates the names, as the English does, so that the reader sees what each one means. "A porta" is also the word for the doors set in a gateway ("as suas portas"), as in Portuguese Bibles.

decisions.choice: Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Eliasibe", the form 1 Chronicles 24:12 uses, and "sumo sacerdote", the Portuguese title of the office, at every level, as the Old Testament terms set it (m1, r-en-1).

decisions.choice: The Sheep Gate "የበጎች በር", as John 5:2 in the Amharic New Testament; a tower (*migdal*) "ማማ" (the Tower of the Hundred "የመቶው ማማ", of Hananel "የሐናንኤል ማማ", of the Ovens "የምድጃዎቹ ማማ"), as the towers at the gates in 2 Chronicles 26:9; the doors of a gate "መዝጊያዎች", its bolts "መቆለፊያዎች", its bars "መወርወሪያዎች"; Eliashib "ኤልያሴብ", as Ezra 10:6.
decisions.reason: "ግንብ" is kept for the citadel (*birah*, 1:1; 2:8), so the wall's towers are "ማማ"; "በር" is the gateway itself, and its wooden leaves are "መዝጊያዎች".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Nehemiah 3 (the English has them in 3:37).
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "भेड़-फाटक"; "सौ का गुम्मट"; "हननेल का गुम्मट"; one name for each gate and tower at every level
decisions.reason: The gates and towers of the wall keep one name each through Nehemiah, at every level, so a reader can follow the circuit round the city. The Sheep Gate is "भेड़-फाटक" as in John 5:2, and a tower is "गुम्मट", as in Chronicles. Gates already named in Chronicles keep those forms: "मछली फाटक" (2 Chronicles 33:14), "घाटी का फाटक" (2 Chronicles 26:9), "घोड़ा-फाटक" (2 Chronicles 23:15).

decisions.choice: "एल्याशीब महायाजक"
decisions.reason: Eliashib keeps the form of 1 Chronicles 24:12; "the great priest" is the title of the high priest, "महायाजक" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "Овечьи ворота", "башня Сотни", "башня Хананеила"
decisions.reason: The gates and towers of Nehemiah 3 have one Russian name each through the book: "Овечьи ворота" as in John 5:2 in this translation, and the towers by the sense of their names.

decisions.choice: "Елиашив"
decisions.reason: The form 1 Chronicles 3:24 uses in this translation; the names of the list follow 1 Chronicles wherever it has them.

decisions.choice: Eliashib "エルヤシブ" (as the priestly course of 1 Chronicles 24:12); hakkohen haggadol "大祭司" every level.
decisions.reason: The English has "high priest" at every level; the name keeps the Chronicles form.

decisions.choice: Gate and tower names translated: sha'ar hatso'n "羊の門", migdal hamme'ah "百の塔", migdal Chanan'el "ハナンエルの塔"; qiddesh "聖別する" (L, B), "神にささげる" (R).
decisions.reason: One form for each gate through chs. 3 and 12; R says what consecrating meant.

decisions.choice: Gates and towers as names with capitals: "Овеча брама" (as John 5:2), "Рибна брама", "Брама Єшана", "Башта Сотні", "Башта Хананеїла", "Башта Печей", "Широка стіна"; "великий священник" (L), "первосвященик" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The gates and towers are the names of places on the wall; "башта" is the usual word for a tower in a city wall. Literal keeps "the great priest", the other levels the title the terms note gives.

source.text: וְעַל־יָד֥וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹסוְעַל־יָד֣וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־אִמְרִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And at his hand built [the] men of Jericho, and at his hand built Zaccur son of Imri.

en.L: And at his side the men of Jericho built, and at their side Zaccur son of Imri built.
en.B: Next to him the men of Jericho built, and next to them Zaccur son of Imri built.
en.R: The men from the town of Jericho built the next part of the wall. Zaccur son of Imri built the part next to theirs.

es.L: Y a su lado edificaron los hombres de Jericó, y a su lado edificó Zacur hijo de Imri.
es.B: Junto a él edificaron los hombres de Jericó, y junto a ellos edificó Zacur hijo de Imri.
es.R: Los hombres del pueblo de Jericó construyeron la parte siguiente del muro. Zacur hijo de Imri construyó la parte que seguía a la de ellos.

fr.L: Et à son côté bâtirent les hommes de Jéricho, et à leur côté bâtit Zakkour, fils d’Imri.
fr.B: À côté de lui bâtirent les hommes de Jéricho, et à côté d’eux bâtit Zakkour, fils d’Imri.
fr.R: Les hommes de la ville de Jéricho ont construit la partie suivante de la muraille. Zakkour, fils d’Imri, a construit la partie d’après.

sw.L: Na kando yake walijenga watu wa Yeriko, na kando yao akajenga Zakuri mwana wa Imri.
sw.B: Karibu naye walijenga watu wa Yeriko, na karibu nao akajenga Zakuri mwana wa Imri.
sw.R: Watu wa mji wa Yeriko walijenga sehemu iliyofuata ya ukuta. Zakuri mwana wa Imri alijenga sehemu iliyofuata yao.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh ông, những người Giê-ri-cô xây, và bên cạnh họ, Xác-cua con trai Im-ri xây.
vi.B: Kế bên ông có những người Giê-ri-cô xây, và kế bên họ có Xác-cua con trai Im-ri xây.
vi.R: Những người từ thành Giê-ri-cô xây đoạn tường kế tiếp. Xác-cua con trai Im-ri xây đoạn kế bên đoạn của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그 곁에서는 여리고 사람들이 건축했고, 그 곁에서는 이므리의 아들 삭굴이 건축했다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 여리고 사람들이 쌓았고, 그 옆은 이므리의 아들 삭굴이 쌓았다.
ko.R: 여리고 성읍 사람들이 그다음 성벽을 쌓았다. 이므리의 아들 삭굴은 그들 다음 부분을 쌓았다.

pt.L: E ao lado dele edificaram os homens de Jericó, e ao lado dele edificou Zacur, filho de Inri.
pt.B: Ao lado dele, os homens de Jericó construíram o muro, e ao lado deles Zacur, filho de Inri, construiu o muro.
pt.R: Os homens da cidade de Jericó construíram a parte seguinte do muro. Zacur, filho de Inri, construiu a parte ao lado da deles.

am.L: በአጠገቡም የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ሠሩ፤ በአጠገባቸውም የኢምሪ ልጅ ዘኩር ሠራ።
am.B: በአጠገቡ የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ሠሩ፤ በአጠገባቸውም የኢምሪ ልጅ ዘኩር ሠራ።
am.R: ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የኢያሪኮ ከተማ ሰዎች ሠሩ። ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የኢምሪ ልጅ ዘኩር ሠራ።

hi.L: और उसके बगल में यरीहो के पुरुषों ने बनाया, और उनके बगल में इम्री के पुत्र जक्कूर ने बनाया।
hi.B: उसके आगे यरीहो के पुरुषों ने बनाया, और उनके आगे इम्री के पुत्र जक्कूर ने बनाया।
hi.R: शहरपनाह का अगला भाग यरीहो नगर के पुरुषों ने बनाया। उनसे अगला भाग इम्री के पुत्र जक्कूर ने बनाया।

ru.L: И возле него строили мужчины Иерихона, и возле них строил Закхур, сын Имрия.
ru.B: Рядом с ним строили жители Иерихона, а рядом с ними строил Закхур, сын Имрия.
ru.R: Люди из города Иерихона строили следующий участок стены. Закхур, сын Имрия, строил участок рядом с ними.

ja.L: 彼の傍らでは、エリコの人々が建てた。彼らの傍らでは、イムリの子ザクルが建てた。
ja.B: その隣では、エリコの人々が建て、その隣では、イムリの子ザクルが建てた。
ja.R: その次の部分は、エリコの町の人々が建てました。そのまた隣の部分は、イムリの息子ザクルが建てました。

uk.L: І біля нього будували мужі Єрихона, а біля них будував Заккур, син Імрі.
uk.B: Поруч з ним будували чоловіки з Єрихона, а поруч з ними будував Заккур, син Імрі.
uk.R: Наступну частину стіни будували чоловіки з міста Єрихона. Заккур, син Імрі, будував частину поруч з ними.

decisions.choice: at his hand: next to him, the next section along the wall
decisions.reason: This phrase, and "after him" from verse 16 on, link each group to the section next to the one before it. "His" in "at his hand" refers back to the last builder named, whether a man or a group, so the next part of the wall is meant.

decisions.choice: the men of Jericho: people from a town in the Jordan valley
decisions.reason: Many builders came from towns outside Jerusalem (verses 5, 7, 13). Jericho's people had returned from exile (Ezra 2:34).

decisions.choice: next to
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "at his hand" means; Literal keeps "at his side", close to the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: "kando yake" (L), "karibu naye" (B) for "at his hand", through the list
decisions.reason: "Mkononi mwake" would read as "in his hand" in Swahili; "kando yake" keeps the picture of the next place along the wall.

decisions.choice: "그 곁에서는" (L), "그 옆은" (B) for "at his hand"; "그다음에는" for "after him", through the list
decisions.reason: Korean names the next stretch of wall plainly; Literal keeps "곁", the nearest word to the Hebrew picture of standing at someone's hand.

decisions.choice: E ao lado dele(s) edificou/reparou X (L); Ao lado dele(s), X construiu/reparou o muro (B); Ao lado deles, X consertou o muro (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole list (3:2-32), one formula per level, repeated: "ao lado dele" says what "at his hand" means, the next section of the wall (m1), at every level. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, verb before the builder; Balanced and Readable put the builder first and name the wall as the object, since Portuguese "reparar" without an object would read as "to notice". "Depois dele" from verse 16 on follows the same pattern. The number of "dele/deles" follows the Hebrew at Literal and the English at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: One formula through the list: "at his / their side X repaired" is "በአጠገቡ(ም) / በአጠገባቸው(ም) X አደሰ" (Literal, Balanced) and "ከእርሱ / ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል X አደሰ" (Readable); "after him X repaired" is "ከእርሱ(ም) / ከእነርሱ በኋላ X አደሰ" at every level; "repaired" (*heḥeziq*, made strong) is "አደሰ" and "built" (*banah*) "ሠራ"; "a second section" is "ሁለተኛውን ክፍል" (Literal) / "ሌላውን ክፍል" (Balanced, Readable).
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's "at his hand" means "beside him"; "በእጁ" would read as "with his hand". Literal keeps the chain of "and" (-ም); the English levels keep "next to" and "after" apart, and so does the Amharic.

decisions.choice: "उसके बगल में" (L); "उसके आगे" (B); "अगला भाग" (R)
decisions.reason: "At his hand" means the next section along the wall (m1). Literal keeps the picture of working side by side; Balanced says "उसके आगे", the next stretch along; Readable names the next part of the wall. The same words are used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: names in the forms of 1 Chronicles
decisions.reason: Names in the builders' list that occur in 1 Chronicles keep its Hindi forms (जक्कूर, इम्री, हक्कोस, मशुल्लाम, बेरेक्याह, सादोक, मल्किय्याह, हारीम, हश्शूब, शल्लूम, हशब्याह, बानी, अजर्याह, मासेयाह, पदायाह, इम्मेर, शमायाह, शकन्याह, शेलेम्याह, हनन्याह); the others follow the Hebrew as the established Hindi Bible forms do, one form each.

decisions.choice: "возле него" (L); "рядом с ним" (B); "следующий участок" (R)
decisions.reason: "At his hand" means the next section along the wall. Literal says "возле", the nearest plain Russian to the Hebrew picture; Balanced "рядом с"; Readable names the section. The same wording runs through the list.

decisions.choice: 'al-yado "彼の傍らで" (L), "その隣では" (B), "その次の部分は" / "その隣の部分は" (R), the formula of the whole list.
decisions.reason: L keeps the Hebrew image of the hand; B and R say the next section along the wall, as the English.

decisions.choice: "біля нього" (L), "поруч з ним" (B, R) for "at his hand"; "лагодив" (L, B), "ремонтував" (R) for the verb of repairing, through chapter 3
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "at his hand" means next to him along the wall; the repeated verb is kept the same at Literal and Balanced, as the list repeats it, and Readable uses the everyday "ремонтувати".

source.text: וְאֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַסְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעוּלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the gate of the fish built [the] sons of Hassenaah; they laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.

en.L: And the Fish Gate the sons of Hassenaah built. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.
en.B: The people of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.
en.R: The people of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate. They put in its wooden beams and set up its doors with their bolts and bars.

es.L: Y la puerta del Pescado la edificaron los hijos de Hasenaa. Ellos le pusieron las vigas y colocaron sus hojas, sus cerrojos y sus barras.
es.B: La gente de Hasenaa edificó la puerta del Pescado. Le pusieron las vigas y colocaron sus hojas, sus cerrojos y sus barras.
es.R: La gente de Hasenaa reconstruyó la puerta del Pescado. Pusieron sus vigas de madera y colocaron sus puertas con sus cerrojos y barras.

fr.L: Et la porte des Poissons, les fils de Hassenaa la bâtirent. Ils en posèrent la charpente et mirent en place ses battants, ses verrous et ses barres.
fr.B: Les gens de Hassenaa bâtirent la porte des Poissons. Ils en posèrent la charpente et mirent en place ses battants, ses verrous et ses barres.
fr.R: Les gens de Hassenaa ont reconstruit la porte des Poissons. Ils ont posé les poutres en bois et mis en place les battants avec leurs verrous et leurs barres.

sw.L: Na Lango la Samaki walilijenga wana wa Hasenaa. Wakaweka boriti zake, wakaisimika milango yake, makomeo yake na mapingo yake.
sw.B: Watu wa Hasenaa walilijenga Lango la Samaki. Waliweka boriti zake, wakaisimika milango yake, makomeo yake na mapingo yake.
sw.R: Watu wa Hasenaa walilijenga upya Lango la Samaki. Waliweka boriti zake za mbao, wakaisimika milango yake pamoja na makomeo na mapingo yake.

vi.L: Và Cổng Cá thì con cái Ha-sê-na xây. Họ đặt xà và lắp các cánh cửa, các chốt và then cửa.
vi.B: Người Ha-sê-na xây Cổng Cá. Họ đặt xà, lắp các cánh cửa, chốt cửa và then cài.
vi.R: Người Ha-sê-na xây lại Cổng Cá. Họ đặt các xà gỗ và lắp các cánh cửa cùng chốt và then cài.

ko.L: 그리고 물고기 문은 하스나아 자손이 건축했다. 그들이 들보를 얹고 그 문짝들과 자물쇠들과 빗장들을 달았다.
ko.B: 하스나아 사람들은 물고기 문을 세웠다. 그들은 들보를 얹고 문짝과 자물쇠와 빗장을 달았다.
ko.R: 하스나아 사람들은 물고기 문을 다시 세웠다. 그들은 나무 들보를 얹고, 자물쇠와 빗장이 달린 문짝들을 달았다.

pt.L: E a Porta dos Peixes edificaram os filhos de Hassenaá; eles colocaram as suas vigas e assentaram as suas portas, as suas fechaduras e as suas trancas.
pt.B: O povo de Hassenaá construiu a Porta dos Peixes. Eles colocaram as suas vigas e assentaram as suas portas, as suas fechaduras e as suas trancas.
pt.R: O povo de Hassenaá reconstruiu a Porta dos Peixes. Eles colocaram as vigas de madeira e assentaram as portas com as suas fechaduras e trancas.

am.L: የዓሣንም በር የሀሴናኣ ልጆች ሠሩ፤ ወራጆቹን ዘረጉ፤ መዝጊያዎቹን፣ መቆለፊያዎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹን አቆሙ።
am.B: የሀሴናኣ ሰዎች የዓሣን በር ሠሩ። ወራጆቹን ዘረጉ፤ መዝጊያዎቹን፣ መቆለፊያዎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹን አቆሙ።
am.R: የሀሴናኣ ሰዎች የዓሣን በር እንደ ገና ሠሩ። የእንጨት ወራጆቹን አኖሩ፤ መዝጊያዎቹንም ከመቆለፊያዎቻቸውና ከመወርወሪያዎቻቸው ጋር አቆሙ።

hi.L: और मछली फाटक हस्सना के पुत्रों ने बनाया। उन्होंने उसकी कड़ियाँ रखीं और उसके किवाड़, उसकी चटकनियाँ और उसके बेंड़े लगाए।
hi.B: हस्सना के लोगों ने मछली फाटक बनाया। उन्होंने उसकी कड़ियाँ रखीं और उसके किवाड़, उसकी चटकनियाँ और उसके बेंड़े लगाए।
hi.R: हस्सना के लोगों ने मछली फाटक को फिर से बनाया। उन्होंने उसमें लकड़ी की कड़ियाँ लगाईं और चटकनियों और बेंड़ों समेत उसके किवाड़ लगाए।

ru.L: А Рыбные ворота строили сыновья Гассенаа; они положили его балки и поставили его двери, его засовы и его запоры.
ru.B: Рыбные ворота строили жители Гассенаа. Они положили балки, поставили двери, засовы и запоры.
ru.R: Жители Гассенаа отстроили Рыбные ворота. Они положили деревянные балки и поставили двери с засовами и запорами.

ja.L: 魚の門は、ハセナアの子らが建てた。彼らはその梁を置き、その扉、その錠、そのかんぬきを取り付けた。
ja.B: ハセナアの人々は魚の門を建てた。彼らはその梁を置き、扉と錠とかんぬきを取り付けた。
ja.R: ハセナアの人々は、魚の門を建て直しました。彼らは木の梁を入れ、扉を取り付けて、錠とかんぬきを付けました。

uk.L: А Рибну браму збудували сини Гассенаї. Вони поклали її балки і поставили її двері, її засуви та її запори.
uk.B: Нащадки Гассенаї збудували Рибну браму. Вони поклали її балки і вставили її двері, засуви й запори.
uk.R: Нащадки Гассенаї відбудували Рибну браму. Вони поклали її деревʼяні балки і вставили її двері із засувами й запорами.

decisions.choice: the Fish Gate: a gate in the north wall
decisions.reason: It was probably where fish brought from the coast were sold (13:16; Zephaniah 1:10; 2 Chronicles 33:14).

decisions.choice: the sons of Hassenaah: the people of Senaah, most likely a town
decisions.reason: The name, with the article, is the same as Senaah in Ezra 2:35, which lists 3,630 of its people. It is most likely a place, so the "sons" are its people.

decisions.choice: beams, doors, bolts and bars: the parts of a city gate
decisions.reason: A gate had wooden beams over the opening, heavy doors, and locks: bolts, and bars laid across the doors from inside (Deuteronomy 3:5; Judges 16:3).

decisions.choice: the people of Hassenaah
decisions.reason: The project's wording for "sons of" a place: "the people of".

decisions.choice: "Hasenaa", with the Hebrew article, beside "Senaa" of Ezra 2:35; "cerrojos" and "barras"
decisions.reason: The English keeps the article in the name here (Hassenaah), so Spanish does too; the meaning decision ties it to Senaah. The bolts and bars of a city gate are "cerrojos" and "barras".

decisions.choice: "Hassenaa" beside "Senaa" of Ezra 2:35; "ses verrous et ses barres"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the Hebrew article as the English does; the meaning decision links it to Senaah.

decisions.choice: "Hasenaa" beside "Senaa" of Ezra 2:35; "makomeo" and "mapingo"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the Hebrew article as the English does. "Komeo" is the bolt and "pingo" the bar laid across a door.

decisions.choice: "Ha-sê-na" beside "Sê-na" of Ezra 2:35; "chốt" and "then"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the Hebrew article as the English does; the meaning decision links it to Senaah.

decisions.choice: "하스나아" beside "스나아" of Ezra 2:35; "자물쇠" and "빗장"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the Hebrew article as the English does; the meaning decision links it to Senaah.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Hassenaá (L); o povo de Hassenaá (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Ezra 2:1 sets it in Portuguese for Ezra-Nehemiah: "os filhos de" a place is "o povo de" at Balanced and Readable (m2). "Hassenaá" keeps the article that is part of the name here, the town Ezra 2:35 calls "Senaá".

decisions.choice: as vigas, as portas, as fechaduras, as trancas
decisions.reason: The four parts of a gate (m3), the same words wherever the list repeats them (verses 6, 13-15): "fechaduras" for the bolts and "trancas" for the bars laid across the doors.

decisions.choice: Hassenaah "ሀሴናኣ"; the Fish Gate "የዓሣ በር" ("እስከ ዓሣ በር", 2 Chronicles 33:14)
decisions.reason: Nehemiah's Hebrew writes the name with the article, as "Hassenaah"; Ezra 2:35 has the shorter form (Senaah, "ሴናኣ"). The same family is probably meant.
The parts of a city gate (m3) have the same words each time they are listed in this chapter: the beams, the doors, the bolts and the bars.

decisions.choice: "его балки ... его двери" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew singular "gate" in the pronoun, "его"; Russian "ворота" is plural, so Balanced and Readable leave the pronoun out.

decisions.choice: sha'ar haddagim "魚の門"; benei Hassena'ah "ハセナアの子ら" (L), "ハセナアの人々" (B, R); delatot, man'ulim, berichim "扉、錠、かんぬき".
decisions.reason: The parts of a gate keep one wording through the chapter.

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן־הַקּ֔וֹץסוְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑לסוְעַל־יָדָ֣ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן־בַּעֲנָֽא׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And at their hand repaired Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz; and at their hand repaired Meshullam son of Berekiah son of Meshezabel; and at their hand repaired Zadok son of Baana.

en.L: And at their side Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired. And at their side Meshullam son of Berekiah son of Meshezabel repaired. And at their side Zadok son of Baana repaired.
en.B: Next to them Meremoth son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz, made repairs. Next to him Meshullam son of Berekiah, son of Meshezabel, made repairs. Next to him Zadok son of Baana made repairs.
en.R: Meremoth son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz repaired the next part. Meshullam son of Berekiah and grandson of Meshezabel repaired the part after that, and Zadok son of Baana the next.

es.L: Y a su lado reparó Meremot hijo de Urías hijo de Cos. Y a su lado reparó Mesulam hijo de Berequías hijo de Mesezabeel. Y a su lado reparó Sadoc hijo de Baana.
es.B: Junto a ellos hizo reparaciones Meremot hijo de Urías, hijo de Cos. Junto a él hizo reparaciones Mesulam hijo de Berequías, hijo de Mesezabeel. Junto a él hizo reparaciones Sadoc hijo de Baana.
es.R: Meremot hijo de Urías y nieto de Cos reparó la parte siguiente. Mesulam hijo de Berequías y nieto de Mesezabeel reparó la parte que seguía, y Sadoc hijo de Baana la siguiente.

fr.L: Et à leur côté répara Merémoth, fils d’Urie, fils de Haqqots. Et à leur côté répara Meshoullam, fils de Bérékia, fils de Meshézabeel. Et à leur côté répara Sadok, fils de Baana.
fr.B: À côté d’eux, Merémoth, fils d’Urie, fils de Haqqots, fit des réparations. À côté de lui, Meshoullam, fils de Bérékia, fils de Meshézabeel, fit des réparations. À côté de lui, Sadok, fils de Baana, fit des réparations.
fr.R: Merémoth, fils d’Urie et petit-fils de Haqqots, a réparé la partie suivante. Meshoullam, fils de Bérékia et petit-fils de Meshézabeel, a réparé la partie d’après, et Sadok, fils de Baana, la suivante.

sw.L: Na kando yao akakarabati Meremothi mwana wa Uria mwana wa Hakosi. Na kando yao akakarabati Meshulamu mwana wa Berekia mwana wa Meshezabeli. Na kando yao akakarabati Sadoki mwana wa Baana.
sw.B: Karibu nao Meremothi mwana wa Uria, mwana wa Hakosi, alifanya ukarabati. Karibu naye Meshulamu mwana wa Berekia, mwana wa Meshezabeli, alifanya ukarabati. Karibu naye Sadoki mwana wa Baana alifanya ukarabati.
sw.R: Meremothi mwana wa Uria na mjukuu wa Hakosi alikarabati sehemu iliyofuata. Meshulamu mwana wa Berekia na mjukuu wa Meshezabeli alikarabati sehemu iliyofuata hiyo, na Sadoki mwana wa Baana sehemu iliyofuata.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh họ, Mê-rê-mốt con trai U-ri, con trai Ha-cốt, sửa chữa. Và bên cạnh họ, Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-rê-kia, con trai Mê-sê-xa-bên, sửa chữa. Và bên cạnh họ, Xa-đốc con trai Ba-a-na sửa chữa.
vi.B: Kế bên họ có Mê-rê-mốt con trai U-ri, cháu Ha-cốt, sửa chữa. Kế bên ông có Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-rê-kia, cháu Mê-sê-xa-bên, sửa chữa. Kế bên ông có Xa-đốc con trai Ba-a-na sửa chữa.
vi.R: Mê-rê-mốt con trai U-ri và là cháu Ha-cốt sửa chữa đoạn kế tiếp. Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-rê-kia và là cháu Mê-sê-xa-bên sửa chữa đoạn sau đó, rồi đến Xa-đốc con trai Ba-a-na sửa chữa đoạn kế tiếp.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 곁에서는 학고스의 손자 우리야의 아들 므레못이 보수했다. 그리고 그들 곁에서는 므세사벨의 손자 베레갸의 아들 므술람이 보수했다. 그리고 그들 곁에서는 바아나의 아들 사독이 보수했다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 학고스의 손자요 우리야의 아들인 므레못이 보수했다. 그 옆은 므세사벨의 손자요 베레갸의 아들인 므술람이 보수했다. 그 옆은 바아나의 아들 사독이 보수했다.
ko.R: 학고스의 손자이며 우리야의 아들인 므레못이 그다음 부분을 보수했다. 므세사벨의 손자이며 베레갸의 아들인 므술람이 그다음 부분을, 바아나의 아들 사독이 또 그다음 부분을 보수했다.

pt.L: E ao lado deles reparou Meremote, filho de Urias, filho de Hacoz; e ao lado deles reparou Mesulão, filho de Berequias, filho de Mesezabel; e ao lado deles reparou Zadoque, filho de Baaná.
pt.B: Ao lado deles, Meremote, filho de Urias, filho de Hacoz, reparou o muro. Ao lado dele, Mesulão, filho de Berequias, filho de Mesezabel, reparou o muro. Ao lado dele, Zadoque, filho de Baaná, reparou o muro.
pt.R: Ao lado deles, Meremote, filho de Urias e neto de Hacoz, consertou o muro. Depois vinha Mesulão, filho de Berequias e neto de Mesezabel, e depois Zadoque, filho de Baaná, que também consertaram o muro.

am.L: በአጠገባቸውም የሀቆጽ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የሜሴዛብኤል ልጅ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የበዓና ልጅ ሳዶቅ አደሰ።
am.B: በአጠገባቸው የሀቆጽ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት አደሰ። በአጠገቡ የሜሴዛብኤል ልጅ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሰ። በአጠገቡ የበዓና ልጅ ሳዶቅ አደሰ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የኦርዮ ልጅና የሀቆጽ የልጅ ልጅ ሜሪሞት አደሰ። ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የበራክያ ልጅና የሜሴዛብኤል የልጅ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሰ። ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የበዓና ልጅ ሳዶቅ አደሰ።

hi.L: और उनके बगल में मरेमोत ने, जो हक्कोस के पुत्र ऊरिय्याह का पुत्र [था], मरम्मत की। और उनके बगल में मशुल्लाम ने, जो मशेजबेल के पुत्र बेरेक्याह का पुत्र [था], मरम्मत की। और उनके बगल में बाना के पुत्र सादोक ने मरम्मत की।
hi.B: उनके आगे मरेमोत ने, जो ऊरिय्याह का पुत्र और हक्कोस का पोता था, मरम्मत की। उसके आगे मशुल्लाम ने, जो बेरेक्याह का पुत्र और मशेजबेल का पोता था, मरम्मत की। उसके आगे बाना के पुत्र सादोक ने मरम्मत की।
hi.R: अगले भाग की मरम्मत मरेमोत ने की, जो ऊरिय्याह का पुत्र और हक्कोस का पोता था। उससे अगले भाग की मरम्मत मशुल्लाम ने की, जो बेरेक्याह का पुत्र और मशेजबेल का पोता था। उससे अगले भाग की मरम्मत बाना के पुत्र सादोक ने की।

ru.L: И возле них чинил Меремоф, сын Урии, сына Гаккоца; и возле них чинил Мешуллам, сын Берехии, сына Мешезавела; и возле них чинил Садок, сын Бааны.
ru.B: Рядом с ними восстанавливал стену Меремоф, сын Урии, сына Гаккоца. Рядом с ним восстанавливал Мешуллам, сын Берехии, сына Мешезавела. Рядом с ним восстанавливал Садок, сын Бааны.
ru.R: Меремоф, сын Урии и внук Гаккоца, чинил следующий участок. Мешуллам, сын Берехии и внук Мешезавела, чинил участок за ним, а Садок, сын Бааны, — следующий.

ja.L: 彼らの傍らでは、ハコツの子ウリヤの子メレモトが修理した。彼らの傍らでは、メシェザブエルの子ベレクヤの子メシュラムが修理した。彼らの傍らでは、バアナの子ツァドクが修理した。
ja.B: その隣では、ハコツの子ウリヤの子メレモトが修理した。その隣では、メシェザブエルの子ベレクヤの子メシュラムが修理した。その隣では、バアナの子ツァドクが修理した。
ja.R: その次の部分は、ウリヤの息子で、ハコツの孫であるメレモトが修理しました。その次は、ベレクヤの息子で、メシェザブエルの孫であるメシュラムが修理し、さらにその次は、バアナの息子ツァドクが修理しました。

uk.L: І біля них лагодив Меремот, син Урії, сина Гаккоца. І біля них лагодив Мешуллам, син Берехії, сина Мешезавеїла. І біля них лагодив Садок, син Баани.
uk.B: Поруч з ними лагодив Меремот, син Урії, сина Гаккоца. Поруч з ним лагодив Мешуллам, син Берехії, сина Мешезавеїла. Поруч з ним лагодив Садок, син Баани.
uk.R: Меремот, син Урії й онук Гаккоца, ремонтував наступну частину. Мешуллам, син Берехії й онук Мешезавеїла, ремонтував частину за нею, а Садок, син Баани, — наступну.

decisions.choice: repaired: made strong, restored
decisions.reason: The verb means to make strong. From here on it is the usual word for the work: some sections were rebuilt, others repaired where the old wall still stood.

decisions.choice: Meremoth and Meshullam: men named again in Ezra and Nehemiah
decisions.reason: Meremoth, of the priestly family of Hakkoz, received the temple silver and gold that Ezra brought (Ezra 8:33); he repaired a second section in verse 21. Meshullam repaired another section in verse 30, and his daughter married Tobiah's son (6:18).

decisions.choice: next to
decisions.reason: As in verse 2: "at his hand" means the next section along the wall, so Balanced and Readable say "next to".

decisions.choice: "reparó" (L), "hizo reparaciones" (B); Hakkoz as "Cos"
decisions.reason: The verb of the list, a plain "repair"; "Cos" is the form already published for this priestly family (Ezra 2:61; 1 Chronicles 24:10).

decisions.choice: "répara" (L), "fit des réparations" (B), "a réparé", "a fait des réparations" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of the list, which means to make strong (meaning decision m1); French says "réparer", as the English "repaired".

decisions.choice: "akakarabati" (L), "alifanya ukarabati" (B), "alikarabati" (R)
decisions.reason: "Kukarabati" is the standard word for repairing a building or wall, used through the list.

decisions.choice: "sửa chữa" for the verb of the list; "bên cạnh" (L), "kế bên" (B) for "at their hand"
decisions.reason: The plain word for repairing a wall, kept through the list so the reader hears the list's refrain.

decisions.choice: "보수했다" for the verb of the list
decisions.reason: "보수" is the current word for repairing a structure; the older "중수" is avoided as archaic.

decisions.choice: reparou (L, B); consertou (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole list: the verb of the work (m1) is "reparar" at Literal and Balanced, the word for mending what is damaged, and "consertar", the everyday word, at Readable. Literal leaves it without an object, as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable add "o muro" (see verse 2).

decisions.choice: Meremote, Mesulão, Hacoz, Berequias, Zadoque, Baaná
decisions.reason: Names already drafted keep their Portuguese forms (Ezra 8:33, 10:29; Ezra 2:61; 2 Samuel 4:2), so that the same men are recognised in verses 21 and 30 and in Ezra (m2).

decisions.choice: Names from Ezra and Chronicles on main keep their forms: Meremoth son of Uriah "የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት" (Ezra 8:33), Hakkoz "ሀቆጽ", Meshullam "ሜሱላም", Berekiah "በራክያ", Zadok "ሳዶቅ", Baana "በዓና"; two generations read "የሀቆጽ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት" (Literal, Balanced) and "የኦርዮ ልጅና የሀቆጽ የልጅ ልጅ" (Readable), as the genealogies in Kings.
decisions.reason: One spelling of each name through Ezra and Nehemiah.

decisions.choice: "मरम्मत की" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb means made strong, restored (m1); in a list of builders the plain Hindi word is "मरम्मत करना", used for repairing the temple in Kings and Chronicles, and it is kept at every level through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "чинил" (L, R); "восстанавливал" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make strong, and here to repair the wall. One word per level runs through the list: "чинил" at Literal and Readable, the literary "восстанавливал" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: hechziq "修理した" at every level; "X son of Y son of Z" "ZのYの子X" (L, B), "Yの息子で、Zの孫であるX" (R), as 2 Kings 22:3.
decisions.reason: The usual genealogy forms of the OT Japanese; names Meremoth "メレモト", Uriah "ウリヤ", Hakkoz "ハコツ", Meshullam "メシュラム", Berekiah "ベレクヤ", Meshezabel "メシェザブエル", Zadok "ツァドク", Baana "バアナ".

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָ֖ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔ם בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And at their hand repaired the Tekoites, and their nobles not brought their neck into [the] service of their lords.

en.L: And at their side the Tekoites repaired, but their nobles did not bring their neck to the service of their lords.
en.B: Next to them the men of Tekoa made repairs, but their nobles would not bow their necks to the work of their masters.
en.R: Next to them the men from Tekoa did repairs. But their leaders refused to work under the men in charge.

es.L: Y a su lado repararon los tecoítas, pero sus nobles no metieron su cuello en el servicio de sus señores.
es.B: Junto a ellos hicieron reparaciones los hombres de Tecoa, pero sus nobles no quisieron doblar la cerviz al trabajo de sus superiores.
es.R: Junto a ellos los hombres de Tecoa hicieron reparaciones. Pero sus líderes se negaron a trabajar bajo los encargados de la obra.

fr.L: Et à leur côté réparèrent les Téqoïtes, mais leurs notables ne mirent pas leur cou au service de leurs seigneurs.
fr.B: À côté d’eux, les hommes de Teqoa firent des réparations, mais leurs notables refusèrent de plier le cou sous le travail de leurs maîtres.
fr.R: À côté d’eux, les hommes de Teqoa ont fait des réparations. Mais leurs chefs ont refusé de travailler sous les ordres des responsables.

sw.L: Na kando yao Watekoa wakakarabati, lakini wakuu wao hawakutia shingo zao katika kazi ya mabwana zao.
sw.B: Karibu nao watu wa Tekoa walifanya ukarabati, lakini wakuu wao hawakukubali kuinamisha shingo zao kwa kazi ya wasimamizi wao.
sw.R: Karibu nao watu wa Tekoa walifanya ukarabati. Lakini viongozi wao walikataa kufanya kazi chini ya wasimamizi.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh họ, người Thê-cô-a sửa chữa, nhưng các nhà quý tộc của họ không chịu ghé cổ vào công việc của các chủ mình.
vi.B: Kế bên họ có người Thê-cô-a sửa chữa, nhưng các nhà quý tộc của họ không chịu cúi cổ làm công việc của những người cai quản họ.
vi.R: Kế bên họ có những người từ Thê-cô-a sửa chữa. Nhưng những người lãnh đạo của họ không chịu làm việc dưới quyền những người chỉ huy.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 곁에서는 드고아 사람들이 보수했으나, 그들의 귀족들은 자기 주인들의 일에 목을 들이밀지 않았다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 드고아 사람들이 보수했다. 그러나 그들의 귀족들은 감독들의 일에 목을 숙이려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그 옆은 드고아 사람들이 보수했다. 그러나 그들의 지도자들은 책임자들 밑에서 일하기를 거부했다.

pt.L: E ao lado deles repararam os tecoítas, mas os seus nobres não puseram o seu pescoço no serviço dos seus senhores.
pt.B: Ao lado deles, os homens de Tecoa repararam o muro, mas os seus nobres não quiseram curvar o pescoço ao trabalho dos seus superiores.
pt.R: Ao lado deles, os homens de Tecoa consertaram o muro. Mas os líderes deles se recusaram a trabalhar sob as ordens dos responsáveis pela obra.

am.L: በአጠገባቸውም ቴቁሐውያን አደሱ፤ መኳንንታቸው ግን አንገታቸውን ለጌቶቻቸው ሥራ አላስገቡም።
am.B: በአጠገባቸው የቴቁሔ ሰዎች አደሱ፤ መኳንንታቸው ግን ለአለቆቻቸው ሥራ አንገታቸውን አላጎነበሱም።
am.R: ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የቴቁሔ ሰዎች አደሱ። መሪዎቻቸው ግን በኃላፊዎቹ ሥር ለመሥራት እምቢ አሉ።

hi.L: और उनके बगल में तकोइयों ने मरम्मत की, पर उनके कुलीनों ने अपने स्वामियों की सेवा में अपनी गर्दन नहीं लगाई।
hi.B: उनके आगे तकोआ के पुरुषों ने मरम्मत की, पर उनके कुलीनों ने अपने स्वामियों के काम के आगे अपनी गर्दन न झुकाई।
hi.R: उनसे अगले भाग की मरम्मत तकोआ के पुरुषों ने की। पर उनके कुलीनों ने काम की देखरेख करनेवालों के अधीन काम करने से इनकार कर दिया।

ru.L: И возле них чинили фекойцы, но знатные их не склонили шеи своей к службе господ своих.
ru.B: Рядом с ними восстанавливали стену жители Фекои, но их знатные не захотели склонить шею для работы под началом своих господ.
ru.R: Рядом с ними чинили стену люди из Фекои. Но их знатные люди отказались работать под началом тех, кто руководил работой.

ja.L: 彼らの傍らでは、テコア人たちが修理した。しかし、彼らの貴族たちは、彼らの主人たちの奉仕に自分たちの首を差し出さなかった。
ja.B: その隣では、テコアの人々が修理した。しかし、その貴族たちは、主人たちの工事に首を差し出そうとはしなかった。
ja.R: その隣では、テコアの人々が修理しました。けれども、そのおもだった人たちは、工事を指揮する人たちの下で働こうとはしませんでした。

uk.L: І біля них лагодили текоїтяни, але їхні знатні не схилили своєї шиї до служби своїх панів.
uk.B: Поруч з ними лагодили чоловіки з Текої, але їхні знатні не схотіли схилити шиї під роботу своїх панів.
uk.R: Поруч з ними ремонтували чоловіки з Текої. Але їхні провідники відмовилися працювати під наглядом тих, хто керував роботою.

decisions.choice: the Tekoites: the people of Tekoa, a town south of Bethlehem
decisions.reason: Tekoa was the home of the prophet Amos (Amos 1:1). Its people repaired a second section too (verse 27), even though their leaders held back.

decisions.choice: did not bring their neck into the service: refused to bend to the work
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox that will not put its neck under the yoke (Jeremiah 27:11-12). The nobles thought the work beneath them, or refused to take part.

decisions.choice: their lords: those over them, most likely the men directing the work
decisions.reason: The word is plural, "lords" or "masters". It most likely means Nehemiah and the officials in charge of the work. It may also be read as "their Lord", God, since this plural form is sometimes used of God.

decisions.choice: nobles (Literal, Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2:16.

decisions.choice: "sus señores" (L), "sus superiores" (B), "los encargados de la obra" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the plural as the men directing the work; lowercase keeps that reading and does not turn it into God.

decisions.choice: não puseram o seu pescoço no serviço dos seus senhores (L); não quiseram curvar o pescoço (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the yoke (m2) and the plural "senhores" (m3), which Portuguese, like the Hebrew, can leave open; Balanced keeps the neck in an idiom Portuguese also uses, "curvar o pescoço"; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The Tekoites "ቴቁሐውያን" (Literal) / "የቴቁሔ ሰዎች" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Tekoa is "ቴቁሔ" and a Tekoite "ቴቁሐዊ" in Chronicles on main; the other levels name the town, as the English.

decisions.choice: "अपनी गर्दन नहीं लगाई" (L); "अपनी गर्दन न झुकाई" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the neck brought to the work; Balanced uses the Hindi idiom of bowing the neck, which says the same refusal (m2); Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "фекойцы" (L); "жители Фекои" (B), "люди из Фекои" (R)
decisions.reason: Tekoa is "Фекоя", as in 2 Samuel 14:2 in this translation; Balanced and Readable say "the people of" the town, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "did not bring their neck" kept as "首を差し出さなかった" (L, B); R says the sense; 'adoneihem "主人たち" (L, B), "工事を指揮する人たち" (R).
decisions.reason: The meaning decision is uncertain who "their lords" are; R follows the English reading (the men directing the work).

source.text: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן־פָּסֵ֔חַ וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן־בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו וּמַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the gate of the Jeshanah repaired Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah; they laid its beams and set up its doors and its bolts and its bars.

en.L: And the Jeshanah Gate Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired. They laid its beams and set up its doors and its bolts and its bars.
en.B: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired the Jeshanah Gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars.
en.R: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired the Jeshanah Gate. They put in its beams and set up its doors with their bolts and bars.

es.L: Y la puerta de Jesaná la repararon Joiada hijo de Paseah y Mesulam hijo de Besodías. Ellos le pusieron las vigas y colocaron sus hojas, sus cerrojos y sus barras.
es.B: Joiada hijo de Paseah y Mesulam hijo de Besodías repararon la puerta de Jesaná. Le pusieron las vigas y colocaron sus hojas, sus cerrojos y sus barras.
es.R: Joiada hijo de Paseah y Mesulam hijo de Besodías repararon la puerta de Jesaná. Pusieron sus vigas y colocaron sus puertas con sus cerrojos y barras.

fr.L: Et la porte de Yeshana, Yoyada, fils de Paséah, et Meshoullam, fils de Besodeya, la réparèrent. Ils en posèrent la charpente et mirent en place ses battants, ses verrous et ses barres.
fr.B: Yoyada, fils de Paséah, et Meshoullam, fils de Besodeya, réparèrent la porte de Yeshana. Ils en posèrent la charpente et mirent en place ses battants, ses verrous et ses barres.
fr.R: Yoyada, fils de Paséah, et Meshoullam, fils de Besodeya, ont réparé la porte de Yeshana. Ils ont posé les poutres et mis en place les battants avec leurs verrous et leurs barres.

sw.L: Na Lango la Yeshana walilikarabati Yoyada mwana wa Pasea na Meshulamu mwana wa Besodeya. Wakaweka boriti zake, wakaisimika milango yake, makomeo yake na mapingo yake.
sw.B: Yoyada mwana wa Pasea na Meshulamu mwana wa Besodeya walilikarabati Lango la Yeshana. Waliweka boriti zake, wakaisimika milango yake, makomeo yake na mapingo yake.
sw.R: Yoyada mwana wa Pasea na Meshulamu mwana wa Besodeya walilikarabati Lango la Yeshana. Waliweka boriti zake, wakaisimika milango yake pamoja na makomeo na mapingo yake.

vi.L: Và Cổng Giê-sa-na thì Giô-gia-đa con trai Pha-sê-a và Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-sô-đia sửa chữa. Họ đặt xà và lắp các cánh cửa, các chốt và then cửa.
vi.B: Giô-gia-đa con trai Pha-sê-a và Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-sô-đia sửa chữa Cổng Giê-sa-na. Họ đặt xà, lắp các cánh cửa, chốt cửa và then cài.
vi.R: Giô-gia-đa con trai Pha-sê-a và Mê-su-lam con trai Bê-sô-đia sửa lại Cổng Giê-sa-na. Họ đặt các xà và lắp các cánh cửa cùng chốt và then cài.

ko.L: 그리고 여사나 문은 바세아의 아들 요야다와 브소드야의 아들 므술람이 보수했다. 그들이 들보를 얹고 그 문짝들과 자물쇠들과 빗장들을 달았다.
ko.B: 바세아의 아들 요야다와 브소드야의 아들 므술람은 여사나 문을 보수했다. 그들은 들보를 얹고 문짝과 자물쇠와 빗장을 달았다.
ko.R: 바세아의 아들 요야다와 브소드야의 아들 므술람이 여사나 문을 보수했다. 그들은 들보를 얹고, 자물쇠와 빗장이 달린 문짝들을 달았다.

pt.L: E a Porta Velha repararam Joiada, filho de Paseia, e Mesulão, filho de Besodias; eles colocaram as suas vigas e assentaram as suas portas, e as suas fechaduras, e as suas trancas.
pt.B: Joiada, filho de Paseia, e Mesulão, filho de Besodias, repararam a Porta Velha. Eles colocaram as suas vigas e assentaram as suas portas, as suas fechaduras e as suas trancas.
pt.R: Joiada, filho de Paseia, e Mesulão, filho de Besodias, consertaram a Porta Velha. Eles colocaram as vigas e assentaram as portas com as suas fechaduras e trancas.

am.L: የይሻናንም በር የፋሴሐ ልጅ ዮያዳና የብሶድያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሱ፤ ወራጆቹን ዘረጉ፤ መዝጊያዎቹን፣ መቆለፊያዎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹን አቆሙ።
am.B: የፋሴሐ ልጅ ዮያዳና የብሶድያ ልጅ ሜሱላም የይሻናን በር አደሱ። ወራጆቹን ዘረጉ፤ መዝጊያዎቹን፣ መቆለፊያዎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹን አቆሙ።

hi.L: और यशाना फाटक की मरम्मत पासेह के पुत्र योयादा और बसोदयाह के पुत्र मशुल्लाम ने की। उन्होंने उसकी कड़ियाँ रखीं और उसके किवाड़ और उसकी चटकनियाँ और उसके बेंड़े लगाए।
hi.B: पासेह के पुत्र योयादा और बसोदयाह के पुत्र मशुल्लाम ने यशाना फाटक की मरम्मत की। उन्होंने उसकी कड़ियाँ रखीं और उसके किवाड़, उसकी चटकनियाँ और उसके बेंड़े लगाए।
hi.R: पासेह के पुत्र योयादा और बसोदयाह के पुत्र मशुल्लाम ने यशाना फाटक की मरम्मत की। उन्होंने उसमें कड़ियाँ लगाईं और चटकनियों और बेंड़ों समेत उसके किवाड़ लगाए।

ru.L: А ворота Иешаны чинили Иояда, сын Пасеаха, и Мешуллам, сын Бесодии; они положили их балки и поставили их двери, и их засовы, и их запоры.
ru.B: Иояда, сын Пасеаха, и Мешуллам, сын Бесодии, восстановили ворота Иешаны. Они положили балки, поставили двери, засовы и запоры.
ru.R: Иояда, сын Пасеаха, и Мешуллам, сын Бесодии, починили ворота Иешаны. Они положили балки и поставили двери с засовами и запорами.

ja.L: エシャナの門は、パセアの子ヨヤダと、ベソデヤの子メシュラムが修理した。彼らはその梁を置き、その扉、その錠、そのかんぬきを取り付けた。
ja.B: パセアの子ヨヤダと、ベソデヤの子メシュラムは、エシャナの門を修理した。彼らはその梁を置き、扉と錠とかんぬきを取り付けた。
ja.R: パセアの息子ヨヤダと、ベソデヤの息子メシュラムは、エシャナの門を修理しました。彼らは梁を入れ、扉を取り付けて、錠とかんぬきを付けました。

uk.L: А Браму Єшана лагодили Йояда, син Пасеаха, і Мешуллам, син Бесодеї. Вони поклали її балки і поставили її двері, і її засуви, і її запори.
uk.B: Йояда, син Пасеаха, і Мешуллам, син Бесодеї, лагодили Браму Єшана. Вони поклали її балки і вставили її двері, засуви й запори.
uk.R: Йояда, син Пасеаха, і Мешуллам, син Бесодеї, ремонтували Браму Єшана. Вони поклали її балки і вставили її двері із засувами й запорами.

decisions.choice: the Jeshanah Gate: a gate of the northwest, named either "the old" or for the town of Jeshanah
decisions.reason: The name means "the old". It may be "the Old Gate", an old gate of the city, or the gate on the road north to the town of Jeshanah (2 Chronicles 13:19), as a gate could be named for where its road led. The name comes again in 12:39.

decisions.choice: "puerta de Jesaná"; "Besodías"
decisions.reason: The gate keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note sets, since the meaning decision leaves open whether it is "the old" gate or the gate toward Jeshanah. Besodeiah is not published elsewhere; this form is used through the book.

decisions.choice: "porte de Yeshana"; "Besodeya"
decisions.reason: The gate keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note sets, since its meaning is open. Besodeiah is not published elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "Lango la Yeshana"; "Besodeya"
decisions.reason: The gate keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note sets, since its meaning is open.

decisions.choice: "Cổng Giê-sa-na"; "Bê-sô-đia"
decisions.reason: The gate keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note sets, since its meaning is open.

decisions.choice: "여사나 문"; "브소드야"
decisions.reason: The gate keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note sets, since its meaning is open.

decisions.choice: a Porta Velha
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 12:39): the name means "the old" (m1), and Portuguese gives the meaning as it does for the other gate names, rather than keep the Hebrew sound as the English does. It loses the other reading, a gate named for the town of Jeshanah.

decisions.choice: The Jeshanah Gate "የይሻና በር", kept as a name at every level, as the English
decisions.reason: The English keeps the Hebrew name, whose sense (old, or the gate toward Jeshanah) is not certain; the Amharic does the same.

decisions.choice: "यशाना फाटक"
decisions.reason: The name may mean "the old" or name the town of Jeshanah (m1); like the English, the Hindi keeps the name itself at every level.

decisions.choice: "ворота Иешаны"
decisions.reason: The name may mean "the old" or name the town of Jeshanah ("Иешана", 2 Chronicles 13:19 in this translation); as the English does, Russian keeps the name rather than choosing one sense, declined as at 12:39.

decisions.choice: sha'ar hayshanah "エシャナの門" at every level, as the English "Jeshanah Gate".
decisions.reason: The meaning is uncertain ("old" or a town), so the name is transcribed, not translated.

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָ֨ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְיָדוֹן֙ הַמֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה לְכִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַנָּהָֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And at their hand repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, [the] men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, for [the] seat of [the] governor of Beyond the River.

en.L: And at their side Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite repaired, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, which belonged to the seat of the governor of Beyond the River.
en.B: Next to them Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite made repairs. They were men of Gibeon and Mizpah, which were under the authority of the governor of the province Beyond the River.
en.R: Next to them Melatiah from Gibeon and Jadon from Meronoth did repairs with the men from Gibeon and Mizpah. These towns were under the governor of the province west of the Euphrates River.

es.L: Y a su lado repararon Melatías el gabaonita y Jadón el meronotita, hombres de Gabaón y de Mizpa, que pertenecían a la sede del gobernador de Más Allá del Río.
es.B: Junto a ellos hicieron reparaciones Melatías el gabaonita y Jadón el meronotita. Eran hombres de Gabaón y de Mizpa, que estaban bajo la autoridad del gobernador de la provincia de Más Allá del Río.
es.R: Junto a ellos hicieron reparaciones Melatías, de Gabaón, y Jadón, de Meronot, con los hombres de Gabaón y de Mizpa. Estas poblaciones estaban bajo el gobernador de la provincia al oeste del río Éufrates.

fr.L: Et à leur côté réparèrent Melatya le Gabaonite et Yadôn le Méronothite, les hommes de Gabaon et de Mitspa, qui relevaient du siège du gouverneur d’Au-delà du Fleuve.
fr.B: À côté d’eux, Melatya le Gabaonite et Yadôn le Méronothite firent des réparations. C’étaient des hommes de Gabaon et de Mitspa, villes placées sous l’autorité du gouverneur de la province d’Au-delà du Fleuve.
fr.R: À côté d’eux, Melatya, de Gabaon, et Yadôn, de Méronoth, ont fait des réparations avec les hommes de Gabaon et de Mitspa. Ces villes dépendaient du gouverneur de la province à l’ouest de l’Euphrate.

sw.L: Na kando yao wakakarabati Melatia Mgibeoni na Yadoni Mmeronothi, watu wa Gibeoni na wa Mizpa, waliokuwa chini ya kiti cha liwali wa Ng'ambo ya Mto.
sw.B: Karibu nao Melatia Mgibeoni na Yadoni Mmeronothi walifanya ukarabati. Hao walikuwa watu wa Gibeoni na Mizpa, miji iliyokuwa chini ya mamlaka ya liwali wa jimbo la Ng'ambo ya Mto.
sw.R: Karibu nao Melatia wa Gibeoni na Yadoni wa Meronothi walifanya ukarabati pamoja na watu wa Gibeoni na Mizpa. Miji hiyo ilikuwa chini ya liwali wa jimbo lililo magharibi ya mto Frati.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh họ, Mê-la-tia người Ga-ba-ôn và Gia-đôn người Mê-rô-nốt sửa chữa, là những người của Ga-ba-ôn và Mích-ba, thuộc về tòa của tổng đốc bên kia Sông.
vi.B: Kế bên họ có Mê-la-tia người Ga-ba-ôn và Gia-đôn người Mê-rô-nốt sửa chữa. Họ là người Ga-ba-ôn và Mích-ba, là những thành thuộc quyền tổng đốc tỉnh Bên Kia Sông.
vi.R: Kế bên họ có Mê-la-tia từ Ga-ba-ôn và Gia-đôn từ Mê-rô-nốt sửa chữa cùng với những người Ga-ba-ôn và Mích-ba. Các thành này thuộc quyền tổng đốc của tỉnh phía tây sông Ơ-phơ-rát.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 곁에서는 기브온 사람 믈라댜와 메로놋 사람 야돈, 곧 강 건너편 총독의 자리에 속한 기브온과 미스바 사람들이 보수했다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 기브온 사람 믈라댜와 메로놋 사람 야돈이 보수했다. 그들은 강 건너편 지방 총독의 관할 아래 있던 기브온과 미스바 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 그 옆은 기브온 출신 믈라댜와 메로놋 출신 야돈이 기브온과 미스바 사람들과 함께 보수했다. 이 성읍들은 유프라테스 강 서쪽 지방 총독의 다스림을 받았다.

pt.L: E ao lado deles reparou Melatias, o gibeonita, e Jadom, o meronotita, os homens de Gibeom e de Mispá, para a sede do governador de Além do Rio.
pt.B: Ao lado deles, Melatias, o gibeonita, e Jadom, o meronotita, repararam o muro. Eram homens de Gibeom e de Mispá, que estavam sob a autoridade do governador da província de Além do Rio.
pt.R: Ao lado deles, Melatias, de Gibeom, e Jadom, de Meronote, consertaram o muro com os homens de Gibeom e de Mispá. Essas cidades estavam sob o governador da província a oeste do Eufrates.

am.L: በአጠገባቸውም ገባዖናዊው መልጥያና ሜሮኖታዊው ያዶን፣ ለወንዝ ማዶ አገረ ገዥ መቀመጫ የሆኑት የገባዖንና የምጽጳ ሰዎች፣ አደሱ።
am.B: በአጠገባቸው ገባዖናዊው መልጥያና ሜሮኖታዊው ያዶን አደሱ። እነርሱም በወንዝ ማዶ አውራጃ አገረ ገዥ ሥልጣን ሥር የነበሩት የገባዖንና የምጽጳ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል ከገባዖን የሆነው መልጥያና ከሜሮኖት የሆነው ያዶን ከገባዖንና ከምጽጳ ሰዎች ጋር አደሱ። እነዚህ ከተሞች ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ በስተ ምዕራብ ባለው አውራጃ አገረ ገዥ ሥር ነበሩ።

hi.L: और उनके बगल में गिबोनी मलत्याह और मेरोनोती यादोन ने, गिबोन और मिस्पा के पुरुषों ने, मरम्मत की, जो नदी-पार के राज्यपाल के आसन के अधीन [थे]।
hi.B: उनके आगे गिबोनी मलत्याह और मेरोनोती यादोन ने मरम्मत की। वे गिबोन और मिस्पा के पुरुष थे, जो नदी-पार के प्रांत के राज्यपाल के अधिकार में थे।
hi.R: उनसे अगले भाग की मरम्मत गिबोन के मलत्याह और मेरोनोत के यादोन ने गिबोन और मिस्पा के पुरुषों के साथ मिलकर की। ये नगर फ़रात नदी के पश्चिम के प्रांत के राज्यपाल के अधीन थे।

ru.L: И возле них чинили Мелатия гаваонитянин и Иадон меронофянин, мужчины Гаваона и Мицпы, для престола наместника Заречья.
ru.B: Рядом с ними восстанавливали стену Мелатия гаваонитянин и Иадон меронофянин, жители Гаваона и Мицпы, которые были под властью наместника области Заречье.
ru.R: Рядом с ними чинили стену Мелатия из Гаваона и Иадон из Меронофа вместе с людьми из Гаваона и Мицпы. Эти города были под властью правителя области к западу от Евфрата.

ja.L: 彼らの傍らでは、ギブオン人メラトヤとメロノト人ヤドン、すなわち川向こうの総督の座に属するギブオンとミツパの人々が修理した。
ja.B: その隣では、ギブオン人メラトヤとメロノト人ヤドンが修理した。彼らは、川向こうの州の総督の管轄下にあったギブオンとミツパの人々であった。
ja.R: その隣では、ギブオン出身のメラトヤと、メロノト出身のヤドンが、ギブオンとミツパの人々と一緒に修理しました。これらの町は、ユーフラテス川の西の州の総督が治めていました。

uk.L: І біля них лагодили Мелатія-гаваонітянин і Ядон-меронотянин, мужі Гаваону і Міцпи, [що належали] до престолу намісника Заріччя.
uk.B: Поруч з ними лагодили Мелатія-гаваонітянин і Ядон-меронотянин. Вони були з Гаваону й Міцпи, які підлягали владі намісника провінції Заріччя.
uk.R: Поруч з ними ремонтували Мелатія з Гаваону і Ядон з Мероноту разом із чоловіками з Гаваону й Міцпи. Ці міста підлягали намісникові провінції на захід від річки Євфрат.

decisions.choice: Gibeon and Mizpah: towns a few miles north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Gibeon (Joshua 9) and Mizpah (1 Samuel 7:5-6) lay in the land of Benjamin. After Jerusalem fell, Mizpah had been the seat of the governor Gedaliah (2 Kings 25:23; Jeremiah 40:6).

decisions.choice: for the seat of the governor of Beyond the River: the phrase is obscure
alternatives: as far as the residence of the governor of Beyond the River
decisions.reason: Word for word it says "to the seat (or throne) of the governor of Beyond the River". It may mean that these towns came under the provincial governor's own authority rather than Judah's, or that Mizpah held his residence for visits; or that these men repaired the wall as far as the governor's residence in Jerusalem. This record takes the first reading.

decisions.choice: next to; the province Beyond the River (Balanced), the province west of the Euphrates River (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2: "at his hand" means the next section along the wall, so Balanced and Readable say "next to". The province name follows 2:7.

decisions.choice: "Melatías", "Jadón"; "el meronotita" as 1 Chronicles 27:30
decisions.reason: Melatiah and Jadon are not published elsewhere; these forms are used through the book.

decisions.choice: "Melatya", "Yadôn"; "le Méronothite" as 1 Chronicles 27:30
decisions.reason: Melatiah and Jadon are not published elsewhere; these forms follow the French spelling of similar names (Rephaya, Yadoua).

decisions.choice: "Melatia", "Yadoni"; "Mmeronothi" as 1 Chronicles 27:30
decisions.reason: Melatiah and Jadon are not published elsewhere; these forms are used through the book.

decisions.choice: "Mê-la-tia", "Gia-đôn"; "người Mê-rô-nốt" as 1 Chronicles 27:30
decisions.reason: Melatiah and Jadon are not published elsewhere; these forms are used through the book.

decisions.choice: "믈라댜", "야돈"; "메로놋 사람" as 1 Chronicles 27:30
decisions.reason: Melatiah and Jadon are not published elsewhere; these forms follow the Korean spelling of similar names (르바야, 여다야).

decisions.choice: para a sede do governador de Além do Rio (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the obscure phrase (m2) word for word, "sede" for the seat of an official; Balanced and Readable follow the reading the English takes. The province name as 2:7.

decisions.choice: Gibeonite "ገባዖናዊ", Meronothite "ሜሮኖታዊ" (1 Chronicles 27:30), Mizpah "ምጽጳ"; the governor's "seat" "መቀመጫ" (Literal), "ሥልጣን" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Forms on main; Balanced says what the seat means, as the English.

decisions.choice: lekhisse' pachat 'ever hannahar "川向こうの総督の座に属する" (L), "川向こうの州の総督の管轄下にあった" (B), "…総督が治めていました" (R); Melatiah "メラトヤ", Jadon "ヤドン", Meronothite "メロノト人".
decisions.reason: The phrase is obscure (meaning decision uncertain); B and R follow the English reading.

source.text: עַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן־חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔יםסוְעַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הָרַקָּחִ֑ים וַיַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: At his hand repaired Uzziel son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths; and at his hand repaired Hananiah, son of the perfumers; and they restored Jerusalem as far as the wall, the broad.

en.L: At his side Uzziel son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths, repaired, and at his side Hananiah, one of the perfumers, repaired. And they restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
en.B: Next to him Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him Hananiah, one of the perfume makers, made repairs. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
en.R: Next to him Uzziel son of Harhaiah did repairs; he was a goldsmith. Next to him Hananiah did repairs; he made perfumes. They restored the city as far as the Broad Wall.

es.L: A su lado reparó Uziel hijo de Harhaía, de los orfebres, y a su lado reparó Hananías, de los perfumistas. Y restauraron Jerusalén hasta el Muro Ancho.
es.B: Junto a él hizo reparaciones Uziel hijo de Harhaía, uno de los orfebres. Junto a él hizo reparaciones Hananías, uno de los perfumistas. Restauraron Jerusalén hasta el Muro Ancho.
es.R: Junto a él hizo reparaciones Uziel hijo de Harhaía; era orfebre. Junto a él hizo reparaciones Hananías; él hacía perfumes. Restauraron la ciudad hasta el Muro Ancho.

fr.L: À son côté répara Ouzziel, fils de Harhaya, des orfèvres, et à son côté répara Hanania, des parfumeurs. Et ils restaurèrent Jérusalem jusqu’à la Muraille large.
fr.B: À côté de lui, Ouzziel, fils de Harhaya, l’un des orfèvres, fit des réparations. À côté de lui, Hanania, l’un des parfumeurs, fit des réparations. Ils restaurèrent Jérusalem jusqu’à la Muraille large.
fr.R: À côté de lui, Ouzziel, fils de Harhaya, a fait des réparations ; il était orfèvre. À côté de lui, Hanania a fait des réparations ; il fabriquait des parfums. Ils ont restauré la ville jusqu’à la Muraille large.

sw.L: Kando yake akakarabati Uzieli mwana wa Harhaya, wa wafua dhahabu, na kando yake akakarabati Hanania, wa watengenezaji wa manukato. Wakaurejesha Yerusalemu mpaka Ukuta Mpana.
sw.B: Karibu naye Uzieli mwana wa Harhaya, mmoja wa wafua dhahabu, alifanya ukarabati. Karibu naye Hanania, mmoja wa watengenezaji wa manukato, alifanya ukarabati. Waliurejesha Yerusalemu mpaka Ukuta Mpana.
sw.R: Karibu naye Uzieli mwana wa Harhaya alifanya ukarabati; yeye alikuwa mfua dhahabu. Karibu naye Hanania alifanya ukarabati; yeye alitengeneza manukato. Waliurejesha mji mpaka Ukuta Mpana.

vi.L: Bên cạnh ông, U-xi-ên con trai Hạt-ha-gia, thuộc các thợ kim hoàn, sửa chữa; và bên cạnh ông, Ha-na-nia, thuộc những người chế dầu thơm, sửa chữa. Và họ tu bổ Giê-ru-sa-lem cho đến Tường Rộng.
vi.B: Kế bên ông có U-xi-ên con trai Hạt-ha-gia, một thợ kim hoàn, sửa chữa. Kế bên ông có Ha-na-nia, một người chế dầu thơm, sửa chữa. Họ tu bổ Giê-ru-sa-lem cho đến Tường Rộng.
vi.R: Kế bên ông có U-xi-ên con trai Hạt-ha-gia sửa chữa; ông là thợ kim hoàn. Kế bên ông có Ha-na-nia sửa chữa; ông làm nghề chế dầu thơm. Họ tu bổ thành cho đến Tường Rộng.

ko.L: 그 곁에서는 금장색들 가운데 할해야의 아들 웃시엘이 보수했고, 그 곁에서는 향품 제조자들 가운데 하나냐가 보수했다. 그리고 그들은 예루살렘을 넓은 성벽까지 복구했다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 금장색 가운데 하나인 할해야의 아들 웃시엘이 보수했다. 그 옆은 향 만드는 사람 가운데 하나인 하나냐가 보수했다. 그들은 예루살렘을 넓은 성벽까지 복구했다.
ko.R: 그 옆은 할해야의 아들 웃시엘이 보수했다. 그는 금세공인이었다. 그 옆은 하나냐가 보수했다. 그는 향을 만드는 사람이었다. 그들은 넓은 성벽까지 성을 복구했다.

pt.L: Ao lado dele reparou Uziel, filho de Haraías, dos ourives, e ao lado dele reparou Hananias, um dos perfumistas; e eles restauraram Jerusalém até o Muro Largo.
pt.B: Ao lado dele, Uziel, filho de Haraías, um dos ourives, reparou o muro. Ao lado dele, Hananias, um dos perfumistas, reparou o muro. Eles restauraram Jerusalém até o Muro Largo.
pt.R: Ao lado dele, Uziel, filho de Haraías, consertou o muro; ele era ourives. Ao lado dele, Hananias consertou o muro; ele fazia perfumes. Eles restauraram a cidade até o Muro Largo.

am.L: በአጠገቡም ከወርቅ አንጥረኞቹ የሐርሐያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል አደሰ፤ በአጠገቡም ከሽቱ ቀማሚዎቹ ሐናንያ አደሰ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ አጸኑ።
am.B: በአጠገቡ ከወርቅ አንጥረኞቹ አንዱ የሐርሐያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል አደሰ። በአጠገቡ ከሽቱ ቀማሚዎቹ አንዱ ሐናንያ አደሰ። ኢየሩሳሌምንም እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ መልሰው ሠሩ።
am.R: ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የሐርሐያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል አደሰ፤ እርሱም ወርቅ አንጥረኛ ነበረ። ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል ሐናንያ አደሰ፤ እርሱም ሽቱ ቀማሚ ነበረ። ከተማዪቱንም እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ መልሰው ሠሩ።

hi.L: उसके बगल में सुनारों में से हर्हयाह के पुत्र उज़्ज़ीएल ने मरम्मत की, और उसके बगल में गंधियों में से एक, हनन्याह, ने मरम्मत की। और उन्होंने यरूशलेम को चौड़ी शहरपनाह तक फिर से ठीक किया।
hi.B: उसके आगे सुनारों में से एक, हर्हयाह के पुत्र उज़्ज़ीएल ने मरम्मत की। उसके आगे इत्र बनानेवालों में से एक, हनन्याह ने मरम्मत की। उन्होंने यरूशलेम को चौड़ी शहरपनाह तक फिर से ठीक किया।
hi.R: उससे अगले भाग की मरम्मत हर्हयाह के पुत्र उज़्ज़ीएल ने की; वह सुनार था। उससे अगले भाग की मरम्मत हनन्याह ने की; वह इत्र बनाता था। उन्होंने नगर को चौड़ी शहरपनाह तक फिर से ठीक किया।

ru.L: Возле него чинил Узиил, сын Хархаии, [из] золотых дел мастеров; и возле него чинил Ханания, [из] составителей благовоний; и они восстановили Иерусалим до Широкой стены.
ru.B: Рядом с ним восстанавливал стену Узиил, сын Хархаии, один из золотых дел мастеров. Рядом с ним восстанавливал Ханания, один из мастеров благовоний. Они восстановили Иерусалим до Широкой стены.
ru.R: Рядом с ним чинил стену Узиил, сын Хархаии; он был золотых дел мастером. Рядом с ним чинил Ханания; он делал благовония. Они восстановили город до Широкой стены.

ja.L: 彼の傍らでは、金細工人のひとり、ハルハヤの子ウジエルが修理した。彼の傍らでは、香料調合人のひとりハナンヤが修理した。彼らは、広い城壁までエルサレムを修復した。
ja.B: その隣では、金細工人のひとり、ハルハヤの子ウジエルが修理した。その隣では、香料作りのひとりハナンヤが修理した。彼らは広い城壁までエルサレムを修復した。
ja.R: その隣では、ハルハヤの息子ウジエルが修理しました。彼は金細工の職人でした。その隣では、ハナンヤが修理しました。彼は香料を作る職人でした。彼らは、広い城壁まで町を修復しました。

uk.L: Біля нього лагодив Уззіїл, син Хархаї, із золотарів, а біля нього лагодив Хананія, із парфумерів. І вони укріпили Єрусалим аж до Широкої стіни.
uk.B: Поруч з ним лагодив Уззіїл, син Хархаї, один із золотарів. Поруч з ним лагодив Хананія, один із виготовлювачів пахощів. Вони відновили Єрусалим аж до Широкої стіни.
uk.R: Поруч з ним ремонтував Уззіїл, син Хархаї; він був золотарем. Поруч з ним ремонтував Хананія; він виготовляв пахощі. Вони відновили місто аж до Широкої стіни.

decisions.choice: goldsmiths, son of the perfumers: members of craft guilds
decisions.reason: "Son of the perfumers" means one of the perfumers, a member of the trade. Craftsmen worked on the wall beside priests and town leaders (also verses 31-32).

decisions.choice: they restored: the sense of the verb is uncertain
alternatives: they left (unbuilt) Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall
decisions.reason: The verb is usually "leave" or "abandon". Here it most likely means "restore" or "repair", a less common sense of the same letters. Read as "leave", the clause would mean that they left a part of Jerusalem unwalled as far as the Broad Wall.

decisions.choice: the Broad Wall: a thick stretch of wall on the west or northwest
decisions.reason: The Broad Wall is named again in 12:38. Remains of a very thick wall from the time of the kings have been found in the Jewish Quarter of the Old City, which may be this wall or part of the same line.

decisions.choice: next to
decisions.reason: As in verse 2: "at his hand" means the next section along the wall, so Balanced and Readable say "next to".

decisions.choice: "ils restaurèrent"; "la Muraille large"
decisions.reason: The verb takes the reading "restore" of the meaning decision; the Broad Wall is named as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "복구했다"; "넓은 성벽"
decisions.reason: The verb takes the reading "restore" of the meaning decision; the Broad Wall is named as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: os ourives; os perfumistas
decisions.reason: The two crafts (m1) in their plain Portuguese names; "boticário" now names a pharmacist.

decisions.choice: "चौड़ी शहरपनाह"
decisions.reason: The Broad Wall (m3) is a stretch of the city wall, so it keeps "शहरपनाह", the word for the wall throughout the book.

decisions.choice: 'azav "修復した"; hachomah harechavah "広い城壁".
decisions.reason: The verb is uncertain; "修復した" follows the English "restored".

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָ֤ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן־ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And at their hand repaired Rephaiah son of Hur, prince of half [the] district of Jerusalem.

en.L: And at their side Rephaiah son of Hur, prince of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired.
en.B: Next to them Rephaiah son of Hur, official over half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
en.R: Next to them Rephaiah son of Hur did repairs. He was the leader of half the district of Jerusalem.

es.L: Y a su lado reparó Refaías hijo de Hur, príncipe de la mitad del distrito de Jerusalén.
es.B: Junto a ellos hizo reparaciones Refaías hijo de Hur, jefe de la mitad del distrito de Jerusalén.
es.R: Junto a ellos hizo reparaciones Refaías hijo de Hur. Él era el líder de la mitad del distrito de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et à leur côté répara Rephaya, fils de Hour, prince de la moitié du district de Jérusalem.
fr.B: À côté d’eux, Rephaya, fils de Hour, responsable de la moitié du district de Jérusalem, fit des réparations.
fr.R: À côté d’eux, Rephaya, fils de Hour, a fait des réparations. Il était le chef de la moitié du district de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Na kando yao akakarabati Refaya mwana wa Huri, mkuu wa nusu ya wilaya ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Karibu nao Refaya mwana wa Huri, afisa wa nusu ya wilaya ya Yerusalemu, alifanya ukarabati.
sw.R: Karibu nao Refaya mwana wa Huri alifanya ukarabati. Yeye alikuwa kiongozi wa nusu ya wilaya ya Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh họ, Rê-pha-gia con trai Hu-rơ, quan trưởng của nửa quận Giê-ru-sa-lem, sửa chữa.
vi.B: Kế bên họ có Rê-pha-gia con trai Hu-rơ, quan chức cai quản nửa quận Giê-ru-sa-lem, sửa chữa.
vi.R: Kế bên họ có Rê-pha-gia con trai Hu-rơ sửa chữa. Ông là người lãnh đạo nửa quận Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 곁에서는 예루살렘 구역 절반의 고관인 훌의 아들 르바야가 보수했다.
ko.B: 그 옆은 예루살렘 구역 절반을 다스리는 관리인 훌의 아들 르바야가 보수했다.
ko.R: 그 옆은 훌의 아들 르바야가 보수했다. 그는 예루살렘 구역 절반의 지도자였다.

pt.L: E ao lado deles reparou Refaías, filho de Hur, príncipe de metade do distrito de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Ao lado deles, Refaías, filho de Hur, oficial de metade do distrito de Jerusalém, reparou o muro.
pt.R: Ao lado deles, Refaías, filho de Hur, consertou o muro. Ele era o líder de metade do distrito de Jerusalém.

am.L: በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ወረዳ እኩሌታ አለቃ የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ አደሰ።
am.B: በአጠገባቸው የኢየሩሳሌም ወረዳ እኩሌታ ኃላፊ የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ አደሰ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ክፍል የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ አደሰ። እርሱም የኢየሩሳሌም ወረዳ እኩሌታ መሪ ነበረ።

hi.L: और उनके बगल में हूर के पुत्र रपायाह ने, जो यरूशलेम के आधे ज़िले का हाकिम [था], मरम्मत की।
hi.B: उनके आगे हूर के पुत्र रपायाह ने, जो यरूशलेम के आधे ज़िले का अगुवा था, मरम्मत की।
hi.R: उनसे अगले भाग की मरम्मत हूर के पुत्र रपायाह ने की। वह यरूशलेम के आधे ज़िले का अगुवा था।

ru.L: И возле них чинил Рефаия, сын Ора, правитель половины округа Иерусалима.
ru.B: Рядом с ними восстанавливал стену Рефаия, сын Ора, правитель половины округа Иерусалима.
ru.R: Рядом с ними чинил стену Рефаия, сын Ора. Он был главой половины округа Иерусалима.

ja.L: 彼らの傍らでは、エルサレム地区の半分の長、フルの子レファヤが修理した。
ja.B: その隣では、エルサレム地区の半分を治める長官、フルの子レファヤが修理した。
ja.R: その隣では、フルの息子レファヤが修理しました。彼は、エルサレム地区の半分の指導者でした。

uk.L: І біля них лагодив Рефая, син Хура, князь половини округу Єрусалима.
uk.B: Поруч з ними лагодив Рефая, син Хура, правитель половини округу Єрусалима.
uk.R: Поруч з ними ремонтував Рефая, син Хура. Він був правителем половини округу Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: official of half the district: the head of an administrative area of Judah
decisions.reason: Judah under Persia was divided into districts, some of them in halves: Jerusalem (verses 9, 12), Beth-haccherem (verse 14), Mizpah (verses 15, 19), Beth-zur (verse 16) and Keilah (verses 17-18). Each had an official at its head, and several of them took a section of the wall.

decisions.choice: prince (Literal); official (Balanced); leader (Readable)
decisions.reason: The project's wording for this title of rank.

decisions.choice: "príncipe" (L), "jefe" (B), "líder" (R) of the "distrito"
decisions.reason: The title of the district heads through chapter 3; Balanced says "jefe", the natural Spanish for the man over a district, where the English says "official".

decisions.choice: "prince" (L), "responsable" (B), "chef" (R) of the "district"
decisions.reason: The title of the district heads through chapter 3, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "mkuu" (L), "afisa" (B), "kiongozi" (R) of the "wilaya"
decisions.reason: The title of the district heads through chapter 3; "wilaya" is the Swahili administrative district.

decisions.choice: "quan trưởng" (L), "quan chức cai quản" (B), "người lãnh đạo" (R) of the "quận"
decisions.reason: The title of the district heads through chapter 3; "quận" names a district within a province.

decisions.choice: "고관" (L), "다스리는 관리" (B), "지도자" (R) of the "구역"
decisions.reason: The title of the district heads through chapter 3, as the Nehemiah drafts render this title.

decisions.choice: príncipe (L); oficial (B); líder (R); o distrito
decisions.reason: The title of rank keeps the words of Ezra 8:20 and Nehemiah 10:1 in Portuguese, as the English levels say "prince", "official" and "leader"; "distrito" for the administrative area (m1), the same in verses 12-18.

decisions.choice: The ruler (*sar*) of a district (*pelekh*): "አለቃ" (Literal) / "ኃላፊ" (Balanced) / "መሪ" (Readable), as the English prince / official / leader; the district "ወረዳ"; half "እኩሌታ"
decisions.reason: "ወረዳ" is the everyday Amharic word for an administrative district; "እኩሌታ" is the half of the half tribe of Manasseh on main.

The title of the men over the districts of Judah (m1) is that of Israel's own leaders (sarim) through Nehemiah: "हाकिम" at Literal and "अगुवा" at Balanced and Readable, as in Ezra, through the chapter; the district is "ज़िला".

decisions.choice: "правитель" (L, B); "глава" (R)
decisions.reason: The title of the men over the districts of Judah, one word per level through the list. "Начальники" is kept for the officials of 2:16, a different Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: sar chatsi pelekh "…地区の半分の長" (L), "…地区の半分を治める長官" (B), "…地区の半分の指導者" (R), the formula of 3:9-19.
decisions.reason: As the English prince / official / leader; pelekh "地区" every level.

decisions.choice: "князь округу" (L), "правитель округу" (B, R) for the sar of a district, through chapter 3
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "prince" as for the king's sarim; the other levels name the office of a man set over a district.

source.text: וְעַל־יָדָ֧ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְנֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹסוְעַל־יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And at their hand repaired Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and opposite his house; and at his hand repaired Hattush son of Hashabneiah.

en.L: And at their side Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired, opposite his own house. And at his side Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired.
en.B: Next to them Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and next to him Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
en.R: Next to them Jedaiah son of Harumaph did repairs across from his own house. Hattush son of Hashabneiah did the next part.

es.L: Y a su lado reparó Jedaías hijo de Harumaf, frente a su propia casa. Y a su lado reparó Hatús hijo de Hasabnías.
es.B: Junto a ellos hizo reparaciones Jedaías hijo de Harumaf frente a su casa, y junto a él hizo reparaciones Hatús hijo de Hasabnías.
es.R: Junto a ellos hizo reparaciones Jedaías hijo de Harumaf, enfrente de su propia casa. Hatús hijo de Hasabnías hizo la parte siguiente.

fr.L: Et à leur côté répara Yedaya, fils de Haroumaph, en face de sa propre maison. Et à son côté répara Hattoush, fils de Hashabnéya.
fr.B: À côté d’eux, Yedaya, fils de Haroumaph, fit des réparations en face de sa maison, et à côté de lui Hattoush, fils de Hashabnéya, fit des réparations.
fr.R: À côté d’eux, Yedaya, fils de Haroumaph, a fait des réparations en face de sa propre maison. Hattoush, fils de Hashabnéya, a fait la partie suivante.

sw.L: Na kando yao akakarabati Yedaya mwana wa Harumafu, mkabala wa nyumba yake mwenyewe. Na kando yake akakarabati Hatushi mwana wa Hashabneya.
sw.B: Karibu nao Yedaya mwana wa Harumafu alifanya ukarabati mkabala wa nyumba yake, na karibu naye Hatushi mwana wa Hashabneya alifanya ukarabati.
sw.R: Karibu nao Yedaya mwana wa Harumafu alifanya ukarabati mkabala wa nyumba yake mwenyewe. Hatushi mwana wa Hashabneya alifanya sehemu iliyofuata.

vi.L: Và bên cạnh họ, Giê-đa-gia con trai Ha-ru-máp sửa chữa, đối diện nhà riêng của mình. Và bên cạnh ông, Hát-túc con trai Ha-sáp-nê-gia sửa chữa.
